No, express shipping isn't available for that plant. XL plants (usually over 4 ft) ship Standard only, so a 5 ft bird of paradise would go Standard.

Here's what to expect:

- **Handling fee:** XL plants add a **$20** handling fee.
- **Standard shipping:** $7.95, or free on orders of **$75+** (after discounts, before tax). Leafy Plus members get free Standard shipping with no minimum.
- **Delivery time** depends on your zone (distance from the nearest greenhouse):
  - Zone 1 (under 300 miles): 2-3 business days
  - Zone 2 (300-1,000 miles): 3-5 business days
  - Zone 3 (over 1,000 miles, remote and island addresses): 5-8 business days
- **Ship days:** Live plants ship Monday-Wednesday only. Orders placed after 12 noon Wednesday ship the next Monday.

If you tell me roughly where you're located, I can help work out which zone applies. I can also pass this to a Support Lead if you're looking for an exception, though I can't promise one would be possible.
